name: print_areas
label: Render targets

spec.name: uuid
spec.label: Saved print area UUID
spec.help: Use the print_area_id returned in data.quads. Provide exactly one target identifier: this UUID for a print area, or a surface UUID.

spec.name: surface_uuid
spec.label: Surface UUID
spec.help: Use the surface_uuid returned in data.surfaces. A surface is one printable product in the photo. Provide exactly one target identifier: this UUID for a surface, or a print area UUID.

spec.name: artwork_url
spec.label: Artwork URL
spec.help: Provide an artwork URL or Base64 value.

spec.name: base64
spec.label: Base64
spec.help: Provide Base64 or an artwork URL. Base64 takes priority.

spec.name: remove_background
spec.label: Remove background
spec.help: Isolates the subject on a transparent background before placing the artwork. Adds 25 credits per unique artwork.

spec.name: position
spec.label: Position
spec.help: Which anchor cell inside the target the artwork is placed against. Horizontal offset and Vertical offset are measured from this anchor. Leave it empty to place at the center. Target pixels are the pixels of the product photo the mockup was built from, and Output size does not change them.

spec.name: coverage
spec.label: Coverage
spec.help: How much of the surface the artwork covers, from 10 to 100 percent. Applies to surface targets. Leave it empty to cover the whole surface. Map Width and Height instead when you need an exact box, and never map both. Mapping Coverage on a print area target is rejected.

spec.name: fit
spec.label: Fit
spec.help: How the artwork sits inside the print area, always against the full area. Applies to print area targets. Leave it empty for Contain. Map Width and Height instead when you need an exact box, and never map both.

spec.name: width
spec.label: Width
spec.help: Artwork width in target pixels. Applies to both target kinds. Map it together with Height. Do not map Fit at the same time on a print area, or Coverage at the same time on a surface. Width and Height are independent, so any aspect ratio is allowed, which is what makes a size drawn on a canvas expressible at all.

spec.name: height
spec.label: Height
spec.help: Artwork height in target pixels. Applies to both target kinds. Map it together with Width. Mapping only one of the two is rejected rather than silently completed, so the aspect ratio is never guessed for you.

spec.name: rotation
spec.label: Rotation
spec.help: Degrees, clockwise positive, from -360 to 360. The artwork is rotated before it is positioned, and a rotated artwork takes up its rotated bounding box, so a 100 by 50 box rotated 45 degrees lands as a 106 by 106 footprint. Width and Height describe the box before rotation.

spec.name: offset_x
spec.label: Horizontal offset
spec.help: Horizontal offset in target pixels, measured from the anchor that Position picks, positive to the right. With the default Position of Center that anchor is the middle of the target.

spec.name: offset_y
spec.label: Vertical offset
spec.help: Vertical offset in target pixels, measured from the anchor that Position picks, positive downward. With the default Position of Center that anchor is the middle of the target.

help: Each render target must provide exactly one identifier: a print area UUID or a surface UUID. Size a print area target with Fit, or with Width and Height. Size a surface target with Coverage.

spec.name: image_size
spec.label: Image size
spec.help: Output image size in pixels, from 100 to 10000.
